name: dsfd_be_f16_m5

job.purpose: Unallocated optional FE sticky-status relay with 16 FF per stage on serial ck. The rn input is a synchronous reset and must receive normal setup/hold input timing, with no reset false path. Default STAGES is zero; six stages is only the FE box distance lower bound, while the unadopted S9 candidate needs a uniform eight stages. Physical source pins, clocks, reset distribution and placement remain open. Data-return latency is unchanged. This standalone physical stress probe uses standard 770ps route/833.333ps signoff constraints, conservatively faster than the requested serial domain; it does not bind any parent clock.
job.hold_merge: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. New unallocated f16 master; no native parent adoption; N9 numerical proof, global source clocks, reset distribution and new consumer ACK remain open.

structural_change: New optional 16-bit status register adding one serial cycle per stage. Source physical pins are unassigned and status latency is explicitly priced. The proposed 32.4 um square outline is unallocated and unrouted.
